stories.title: Scoreboard Bully
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers straight - someone else's problem now

stories.title: Leading the Way
stories.detail: Garry Mattingly holding 23 pts - top of the table like the Dolphins, young comp, old head

stories.title: No Blanks, No Blemishes
stories.detail: 2 points or better on every hole through 9 - not a blemish yet

stories.title: The Metronome
stories.detail: 9 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 2 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: One Step Forward...
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 8, 1-pointer on hole 9

stories.title: Two's Company
stories.detail: 3-pointers on holes 7 & 8 - this is momentum

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 6, 7 & 8 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Rock Solid
stories.detail: Zero wipes and 6 two-pointers - boring in the best way

stories.title: Fast Starter
stories.detail: Nine-plus out of the gate - 9 in the opening three

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Rough Patch
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 16 & 17 - club still in the bag

stories.title: The Null Hypothesis
stories.detail: 5 twos on holes 3-7 - the scorecard is a flatline

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 4 twos on the bounce on holes 3-6

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 14, 15 & 16 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Speed Bump
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 14, wipe on hole 15 - the course corrects

stories.title: Textbook Stuff
stories.detail: 5 twos in a row on holes 1-5 - not a bad thing, actually

stories.title: The Bounce Back
stories.detail: Wipe then a 3-pointer on holes 13 & 14

stories.title: The Golf Tax
stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 5 & 6 - the course charges a fee for everything

stories.title: Brilliant and Then Not
stories.detail: 4-pointer on hole 13, wipe on hole 14 - the heart rate approves

stories.detail: 3-pointer straight into a 1-pointer on holes 11 & 12
